objective: Clothing Store Management System — Master Prompt 2 of 4: Purchasing, Supplier Management, Warehouse Transfers, POS, Returns & Financial Integrity
acceptance_criteria: Supplier management exclusive to Super Admin with duplicate warnings and financial ledgers
Purchase order lifecycle (Draft -> Submitted -> Super Admin Approved -> Partially/Fully Received -> Completed)
Purchase receiving with separate tracking of ordered, received, accepted, shortage, excess, and damaged quantities
Landed cost calculation and Weighted Average Cost (WAC) inventory valuation method
Warehouse and inter-store transfers with request, approval, dispatch (in-transit deduction), and receiving confirmation
Production-oriented POS checkout with barcode scanning, price lookup, promotions, tax calculation, and BDT rounding
Multi-method split payments (Cash, bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Card) with change calculation and server validation
Scheduled promotional discounts without stacking and configurable tax rates
80mm printable thermal receipt generation and reprint capability without creating duplicate sales
Seven-day return policy, receipt lookup, receiptless return manager approval, and Sellable/Damaged/Defective stock classification
Exchange difference settlement (collect or refund) and permanent linkage to original invoice
Supplier returns with damaged/excess stock reduction and credit/cash settlement
Customer records with loyalty point earning, redemption (1 point = 1 BDT), and return reversal
Daily cash control with opening cash, cash sales/refunds tracking, expected vs actual closing, and day locking
Concurrency-safe global transaction numbering and secure QR code verification
Role permissions preventing cashiers and store managers from accessing unauthorized financial data or other store records
Comprehensive automated tests covering purchasing, costing, transfers, POS, split payments, returns, cash closing, and rollback
non_goals: Do not implement offline sales or offline transaction queues
Do not implement salary, attendance, or accounting ledger exports (deferred to Prompt 3)
